rules: The workbench stores references and strategy state, not copies of operating facts.
Calculated metrics, data coverage and health status refresh without a model call.
Node interpretation is on-demand and cached by source fingerprint, prompt version and knowledge version.
Rule thresholds create candidate signals only; they never become final problems or opportunities before expert review.
Every expert signal references immutable evidence ids and declares comparison basis, confidence and missing facts.
Unconfirmed cause lowers confidence but does not block metric-linked solution exploration or small tests.
A solution is hard-blocked only when the target metric cannot be computed, its definition is unclear, or the tactic cannot bind to an observable metric.
Long-term opportunities persist across periods and only update evidence, priority or status.
Tactics persist independently from weekly data; validation results update their status.
Finalized weekly conclusions and accepted experiences are reusable knowledge sources.
Solution directions are retrieved from stable levers; tactics are retrieved from the versioned knowledge catalog before AI ranking.
A tactic plan is not an experience until an execution result is validated and its boundary is confirmed.

relationRules: goal and decision are scoped to project or venue and must retain sourceRefs when available
operating_fact may support a hypothesis but does not prove its causal claim
validation and execution_task may update an experience candidate, but cannot publish an experience without result evidence
candidate_experience and unknown are never formal retrieval sources

nodeAnalysisRequest.period: explicit start, end, timezone and period id
nodeAnalysisRequest.scope: venue or all with a display label
nodeAnalysisRequest.node: stable operating node, metric coverage and metric definition
nodeAnalysisRequest.metricDefinition: aggregation grain, unit, formula and comparison policy
nodeAnalysisRequest.evidenceRegistry: immutable id-addressable values calculated by the program
nodeAnalysisRequest.comparisonSet: previous comparable period, rolling four-week baseline and up-to-eight-week trend
nodeAnalysisRequest.candidateSignals: program-detected candidates that require expert review
nodeAnalysisRequest.dynamicSignals: signals from the selected weekly review
nodeAnalysisRequest.longTermOpportunities: persisted opportunities linked to the node
nodeAnalysisRequest.operatingContexts: historical events, execution and confirmed reasons
nodeAnalysisRequest.availableLevers: stable solution levers allowed for this node
nodeAnalysisRequest.calendarContext: matched operating calendar entries with causal boundaries
nodeAnalysisRequest.industryContext: explicit industry taxonomy, benchmark policy and zero or more sourced comparable benchmarks
nodeAnalysisRequest.projectProfile: stable project, product, audience, funnel, asset and operating-constraint context
nodeAnalysisRequest.venueProfile: current venue audience, traffic, space, staffing and constraint context
nodeAnalysisRequest.tacticCandidates: knowledge-catalog tactics allowed for model ranking

nodeAnalysisResponse.statusSummary: evidence-bounded interpretation of the selected period and scope
nodeAnalysisResponse.expertSignals: zero to five reviewed signals with include, kind, status, evidence refs, comparison basis, hypothesis, counterevidence, confidence, missing facts and a focused question
nodeAnalysisResponse.benchmarkAvailable: whether a same-definition industry benchmark was actually supplied
nodeAnalysisResponse.tacticRationales: fit explanations keyed by an allowed tactic id
nodeAnalysisResponse.analysisBoundary: missing facts, uncertainty and causal boundary

longTermOpportunity.title: stable opportunity statement
longTermOpportunity.sourceType: finalized weekly review or confirmed AI candidate

validation.status: 待验证, 验证中, 已验证 or 已否定
validation.aiReview: evidence review, confounders, comparability, retest and experience-candidate recommendation

tacticPlan.id: stable id from period, venue, node, opportunity and tactic
tacticPlan.knowledgeVersion: knowledge catalog version used for retrieval
tacticPlan.measurableGoal: target metric, formula, baseline, target value, target window and rationale
tacticPlan.executionDesign: one complete path with audience, scenario, mechanism, ordered stages and resources
tacticPlan.measurement: primary, secondary and guardrail metrics, test days, comparison, success, stop and recording rules
tacticPlan.technical: requirements and search terms only; never fabricated repositories
